messages:
maria: Heads-up — release-day apply window starts in ~20m. Need an operator latch holder for staged serial TF applies (staging -> prod). Will pin provider and module versions. Rollback plan in-thread, please ack.
rahul: I can take the first latch window (0–30m). Will watch deploybot and logs.
kai: I can cover second half. What are the hard rollback triggers?
maria: Rollback triggers: sustained >10% 5xx across services for 5m, failed route-table diffs that remove expected routes, deploybot status = "apply-failed" or manual data-exfil concern. If any trigger fires we stop further applies and run the rollback playbook below.
leo: Adding note — if route53 weight shift increases errors, we abort and shift back to 0% immediately.
rahul: Got it. What about provider/module pinning? I want to avoid surprise tf provider upgrades in the middle.
maria: We'll pin terraform provider versions in the release branch. Example snippet we pushed to the branch:```hclprovider "aws" {  version = "~> 4.62.0"  region  = var.region}```Also pinned modules to exact tags.
kai: For clarity, deploybot should pause after each major module apply for manual ack. Can we enforce a human-confirm break?
maria: Yep — deploybot will run serial applies with a manual-hold at module boundaries. It will post a summary and wait for "continue" reaction.
dev-deploybot: deploybot: scheduled serial apply (staging -> prod) in 15m. Pin map: provider=v4.62.0, modules pinned to release-2026-03-21. Pauses at modules: vpc, iam, k8s-ingress. Will wait for "maria" or latch-holder ack.
ops-oncall: I have emergency escape hatch ready (revert-state lambda + immediate infra-drift lock). Will be on standby.
sre-jen: Post-apply check: KV cache invalidation + canary traffic smoke. If errors, run metrics-playbook and open pager.
maria: Rollback playbook (condensed):```bash# stop further appliesdeploybot cancel --queue $RELEASE_TAG# reconcile last known good stategit checkout release/last-known-good# targeted rollback for problematic modulecd infra/terraform && terraform apply -target=module.vpc -var-file=rollback.tfvars# quick restore of small-network diffs scripts/restore-route53.sh $OLD_RECORDS# re-run healthchecks ./scripts/postapply-smoke.sh```
leo: For traffic shifting we'll do a staged weight change: 10% -> 40% -> 100% over 30m with 5m observation windows. If 5xx >10% in any window, revert to previous weight and escalate.
rahul: I'm adding a quick terraform plan preflight command that CI will run 5m before apply:```bashterraform plan -var-file=release.tfvars -out=plan.out```and we'll attach plan.out to the thread for manual inspection.
maria: Link to runbook and release notes (internal): https://internal.redwood/release/runbook/2026-03-21 — add your checklist items there.
dev-deploybot: deploybot: preflight checks pass. Will start serial apply in 10m. Will post module diffs before each pause.
ops-oncall: tagging runbook with oncall rotation and pager contacts.
sre-jen: small ask — add KV prefix whitelist to the plan so eviction doesn't affect prod cache for 10m post-apply.
kai: acknowledged. I'll be watching route53 and gateway logs for the second window.
rahul: Confirming latch handoff at t+30m to @kai. I'll post an explicit "handoff" reaction when I release.
maria: OK locking the release branch now and adding short release-note line. Good luck all — call out asap if deploybot flags anything. :thumbsup:
